import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_48/test_0.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold transformed DataFrames from each source
    transformed_dfs = []

    for file_path in source_files:
        # Load source data
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Inspect columns: ['Text Date', 'Value Date', 'Zip Code', 'Water Use', 'Power Use']
        # Target schema: ['Date': string, 'Water Use': float, 'Power Use': integer]

        # We will group by 'Text Date' (string) as the Date column in target
        # Aggregate Water Use by sum (float)
        # Aggregate Power Use by sum (integer)

        # Convert Power Use to numeric (in case of any issues)
        df['Power Use'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Power Use'], errors='coerce')
        df['Water Use'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Water Use'], errors='coerce')

        # Group by 'Text Date' and aggregate
        grouped = df.groupby('Text Date', as_index=False).agg({
            'Water Use': 'sum',
            'Power Use': 'sum'
        })

        # Rename 'Text Date' to 'Date' to match target schema
        grouped.rename(columns={'Text Date': 'Date'}, inplace=True)

        # Ensure data types match target schema
        grouped['Date'] = grouped['Date'].astype(str)
        grouped['Water Use'] = grouped['Water Use'].astype(float)
        grouped['Power Use'] = grouped['Power Use'].fillna(0).astype(int)

        transformed_dfs.append(grouped)

    # Concatenate all transformed dataframes (if multiple sources)
    target_df = pd.concat(transformed_dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # After concatenation, there might be duplicate Dates from different sources,
    # so aggregate again by Date to get final sums
    target_df = target_df.groupby('Date', as_index=False).agg({
        'Water Use': 'sum',
        'Power Use': 'sum'
    })

    # Ensure final dtypes
    target_df['Date'] = target_df['Date'].astype(str)
    target_df['Water Use'] = target_df['Water Use'].astype(float)
    target_df['Power Use'] = target_df['Power Use'].astype(int)

    # Write to target CSV
    target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_48/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
